integrity: The exact claim is proved by affine normalization and Schneider’s necessary-and-sufficient middle-line criterion; finite numerical experiments are not used as proof.
limitations: The theorem assumes a nondegenerate convex quadrilateral with no pair of parallel sides; trapezoids and parallelograms are not classified here.
The proof uses Schneider’s planar reflection criterion and does not assert a higher-dimensional analogue.
title: Exactly three convexity points for quadrilaterals without parallel sides
